:::: {.concept-card key="numerical-solver" tags="computer-software mathematics"}
## numerical solver

An algorithm that approximates the solution to a mathematical problem.
For an ordinary differential equation, it computes successive approximate states from a derivative field.
::::

:::: {.concept-card key="pseudorandom-seed" tags="computer-software"}
## pseudorandom seed

A value used to initialise a deterministic random-number generator.
Reusing it with the same algorithm and draw sequence reproduces the same sequence; successive draws within that sequence can still differ.
::::
